Modern complex
in the heart of Rivne
aboutPage.text1: «Central Hotels & Restaurants» is a complex of hotels and restaurants of the «Papa&Mama» network, located in the central part of the city. The «Central» and «Mono» hotels together offer 62 comfortable rooms with a modern interior, from single to double rooms, some of which overlook the main square. The complex also has an electric charging station for guests traveling by electric vehicles.
aboutPage.text2: The «Papa&Mama» network also offers recreation in the hotel and restaurant complex «4x4», located on the Rivne bypass road. Here guests can enjoy a comfortable stay at the «4x4» hotel, as well as delicious cuisine in the «Porshen» and «4x4» restaurants.
